name: Mire Fishing Derby

start.dialog: Fang says I need to relax more. So... fishing! The Mire has the weirdest fish! Want to join me? We can see who catches the biggest one!
start.objective: Compete with Vanille to catch the biggest fish in the Mire

progress.dialog: Ooh! I got a bite! This one's big! Really big!
progress.objective: Continue fishing and catch bigger fish than Vanille

complete.dialog: You won! Look at that fish! It's huge! Here - take this fishing rod. It's lucky! And this - a bangle from my collection. It'll keep you safe!

party_comments.kade: Fishing in the Mire. I hope that thing is actually a fish.
party_comments.twist: I caught something! It's... it's looking at me!
party_comments.renna: Mire fish exhibit interesting mutations. Documenting.

hidden_outcome: If you catch the legendary 'Mire Leviathan' (rare spawn), Vanille gives you 'Malboro Wand' - her ultimate weapon
